Visual relationships

How to read this atlas

Select a frame in either view or the list. Its closest visual matches are ranked using the full embedding, not distance in the two dimensional plot. Nearby camera positions can show different crowns. Unlabelled matches are suggestions for inspection, not identifications.

The same PCA components color both views. Projection and color compress information and do not establish biological similarity, habitat classes, species, or crown boundaries. The source encoder and artifact hashes below identify this frozen representation. This is not an AlphaEarth habitat product.
